description: Bloys van Treslongstraat 5-59 (BAG 1933-35): 6.1 m dark red-brown brick pands of three storeys under a dark tiled roof, on storeys 1-2 a canted erker (2.5 m) 1.3 m in from the left party wall and one 1.4 m window against the right, the window pairing with the mirrored neighbour's across the party wall; ground: two windows and the paired house doors under a light canopy; a light cornice band at 9.9 m and a tiled roof rising behind it with small dormers

match.note: Treslongstraat 5-51 (1933-35, 24 pands of 6.1-6.3 m, 3DBAG eaves 11.2-12.3 m, ridge 13.3-14.5): the front gutter stands at 9.9 m on the strip, 3DBAG reads the roof behind. 53-59 (1923) are another design. The bay window is told from the plain pand by the photo (auto-place --photo-decides)

gutter.note: Treslongstraat 5-59 strip: a light cornice band at 9.8-10.0 m, the dark tiled roof rising to 12.3 m with small white dormers (2.0 m wide) and roof windows; not drawn: dormers; dormer: one white box dormer per pand, 2.0 m wide (Treslongstraat 5-59 strip)

door-right.note: paired house doors (1.0 m each, 0-2.3 m) at the party wall under a light canopy at 3.0 m, two ground windows 0.9-2.5 m beside them; mirrored when the strip reads the doors on the left

roof.evidence: Treslongstraat 5-59 strip: dark tile plane from the 9.9 m cornice to 12.3 m, roof windows
